summary: The main article describes an organophotocatalyzed Csp3-Csp2 cross-coupling reaction using 4CzIPN as a photocatalyst. It includes 5 schemes detailing reaction mechanisms and substrate scopes, and 1 table summarizing the optimization of reaction conditions.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Novel cross coupling reactions.
items.description: Comparison of previous dual catalysis and photoredox methods with the current metal-free approach for Csp3-Csp2 coupling.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Proposed 4CzIPN photoinduced Csp 3 ˗ Csp 2 bond forming cross coupling reaction.
items.description: Proposed catalytic cycle involving single electron transfer (SET) decarboxylation and radical addition to vinyl halides.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Exploration and optimization.
items.description: Optimization of reaction parameters including time, light, photocatalyst, and scale-up conditions.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Substrate scope for the photocatalyzed Csp 3 ˗ Csp 2 bond forming cross coupling reaction producing E -products.
items.description: Demonstrates the variety of carboxylic acids and vinyl bromides that yield E-alkenes under short irradiation times.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: Photocatalyzed Csp 3 ˗ Csp 2 bond forming cross coupling reactions producing Z -products.
items.description: Shows the scope for producing Z-enriched alkene products by extending the irradiation time to 6 days.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: Reactions designed for understanding of reaction mechanistic aspects.
items.description: Mechanistic studies using Z-vinyl halides, vinyl fluorides, and vinyl acetates to probe the reaction pathway.
